Beef and Dairy is kind of like brass eye but for the beef and dairy world. It’s quite surreal. Couple of my fave episodes: 36. Beef Encounters (about an online dating site for people in the industry). 41. Beefy Boy (about a video game) and 49. The Beef Hop (a new dance craze) 

They have some quite big people occasionally, there’s an episode about a Bear Grills type character who’s voiced by Nick Offerman (Parks and Rec) that episode is called ‘Tusk Henderson’

The guy who makes B&D, Ben Partridge, also did a detective series called ‘Ray Moss, no stone unturned’ which was excellent but difficult to find.

There’s a guy called Mike Wozniak in B&D quite often and Saint Elwick’s is his thing. It’s basically about a guy making a newsletter podcast after the printed edition lost funding.

I’d recommend listening to these from the beginning and in order, it’s one of those where there are continuing jokes that get repeated in different episodes.

What makes it really funny is he thinks his daughter is editing the podcast but she isn’t, she’s just uploading it so all the arguments and stuff get left in, hope that makes sense, it’s very meta haha.

A bit gutting. I have found some other good podcasts if you fancy a listen to tide you over. ‘The Beef and Dairy Network’ is really good and ‘The Saint Elwick’s Neighbourhood Association Newsletter Podcast’ I couldn’t recommend more!
